benchmarks.baseline: well-sourced Markdown with same claim fields and reference pointers
benchmarks.enhanced: schema-checked JSON research cards plus Markdown projection

cards.baseline: Well-sourced introductory psychology and ordinary measurement model.
cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Specify shared stimulus, record observer variation and interventions; reserve ontology as a separate question.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: No prediction or explanation beyond ordinary observation models.
cards.proposal: A model can be observer-conditioned without the external world being unreal.
cards.source_gaps: Public pointers are research framing, not claim proof.
cards.strongest_rival: Strictly world-independent perceptions or metaphysical idealism.
cards.title: Reality, observer, and model are different

cards.baseline: Two distinct observers in a shared communication network.
cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Construct a two-observer countermodel where connectedness holds and distinctness also holds; open individualism requires a separate identity argument.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Countermodel impossible under explicit defensible identity axioms; otherwise maintain both branches.
cards.nonclaim: No accepted empirical discriminator for shared self is claimed.
cards.proposal: Entities can be connected by shared relations yet remain numerically distinct.
cards.source_gaps: Public pointers are research framing, not claim proof.
cards.strongest_rival: Open individualism positing a single underlying subject.
cards.title: Universal relatedness does not imply one personal identity

cards.baseline: Compare an impersonal pantheistic model with an agentive model.
cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Write interpretations in which God=U is true and Wants(God,x) is undefined/false; demand independent premises for intention.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Independent persuasive agentive premises are supplied and reviewed.
cards.nonclaim: No revelation or instruction from God has been observed.
cards.proposal: A stipulated equation God := Universe says nothing alone about what the totality wants.
cards.source_gaps: Some underlying donor evidence is private; independent public source verification pending.
cards.strongest_rival: Personal/intentional deity with independent purpose-bearing claims.
cards.title: God-as-totality does not logically imply divine intention

cards.baseline: Condition on an observer being able to report a history; compare unconditional and conditional likelihoods.
cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Build a finite sample-space toy that shows observer selection and discuss limits of extrapolating to cosmology.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: A selected model provides distinct prior predictions and supported evidence.
cards.nonclaim: A toy selection effect does not disprove a deity.
cards.proposal: A strikingly improbable personal history alone does not prove a guided pathway.
cards.source_gaps: Some underlying donor evidence is private; independent public source verification pending.
cards.strongest_rival: Intentional selection of a particular outcome.
cards.title: Contingency and observer-selection

cards.baseline: Strong Markdown table with explicit four-value definitions and source links.
cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Feed renderer malformed status mappings; require loss logging and rejection for status upgrades; compare Markdown + automation.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Baseline is clearer or lower cost at equal accuracy.
cards.nonclaim: A typed field is not a new mathematical foundation.
cards.potential_receiver_benefit: Avoid fictional certainty in CoNull and CoTime.
cards.proposal: A typed evidence system can prevent UNKNOWN, NOT_OBSERVED, ABSENT, and MEASURED_ZERO from being silently exchanged.
cards.source_gaps: Some underlying donor evidence is private; independent public source verification pending.
cards.strongest_rival: A carefully designed plain-text evidence table already suffices.
cards.title: Typed nothing, unknown, absence and zero

cards.baseline: Well-structured Markdown plus exact Git history and source links.
cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Render then decode the identifier and type; inject missing provenance and record which transformations fail.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Reference baseline matches reliability at lower burden.
cards.nonclaim: Projections are not proof of ontology.
cards.proposal: A claim ID, evidence type, and revision can remain referentially stable across text and graph views.
cards.source_gaps: Public pointers are research framing, not claim proof.
cards.strongest_rival: Existing W3C PROV / standard linked documents or version control suffice.
cards.title: Hypothesis identity survives view changes

cards.baseline: Equal-budget strong plain-text brainstorming with separate expert-informed source summaries.
cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Preregister novelty, falsifiability and utility rubrics; blind judges to origin; include negative controls and cost.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: No gain after accounting for reviewer agreement, effort and confounds.
cards.nonclaim: Emergence is not yet a measured novelty mechanism.
cards.potential_receiver_benefit: Improve useful research question generation rather than asset count.
cards.proposal: Cross-domain synthesis may yield useful, independently challengeable questions not proposed by source strands alone.
cards.source_gaps: Public pointers are research framing, not claim proof.
cards.strongest_rival: Concatenation, generic prompting or random association yields similar quality.
cards.title: Emergent insight requires more than recombination count

cards.baseline: A conventional model comparison table with versioned links.
cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Inject cycles, stale references and competing claims; ensure termination, no implicit merge, and exact version retention.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Braid loses information or consumes substantially more work than baseline.
cards.nonclaim: No proof of operational superiority or runtime self-coordination.
cards.potential_receiver_benefit: Retain minority views and preserve alternative futures.
cards.proposal: A typed, bounded braid can retain incompatible models with context, uncertainty and lineage.
cards.source_gaps: Public pointers are research framing, not claim proof.
cards.strongest_rival: Simple indexed Markdown notes and a standard knowledge graph provide equivalent value.
cards.title: Golden braid preserves rivals instead of averaging them

cards.baseline: Supply-only, demand-only, combined, and random policies under matched budgets.
cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Create synthetic decision records, preregister axes and report Pareto incomparability, harms, cost and no-gain cases.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Alternative methods dominate or rights/consent costs outweigh benefits.
cards.nonclaim: G_dSide is not a detected spiritual force or an authority source.
cards.potential_receiver_benefit: Represent interests of future and unrepresented stakeholders.
cards.proposal: Compare plural candidate futures against demand/supply baselines using agency, wellbeing, rights and reversibility.
cards.source_gaps: Public pointers are research framing, not claim proof.
cards.strongest_rival: Demand/supply or a simple hybrid can outperform G_dSide proposals.
cards.title: G_dSide as revisable value inquiry, not divine command

cards.baseline: A citation-backed research page without a new designation.
cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Compare reviewer comprehension and attribution errors; require independent issuer, consent and policy before any recognition scheme.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Dossier confuses readers about qualifications or lacks added utility.
cards.nonclaim: Zero DhP awards, endorsements, nominations or doctorate equivalences asserted.
cards.proposal: A public-safe, challengeable research dossier can document work without conferring any title.
cards.source_gaps: Some underlying donor evidence is private; independent public source verification pending.
cards.strongest_rival: Conventional research portfolio, ORCID, institutional repositories and peer review already cover the need.
cards.title: DhP research dossiers are not credentials

cards.baseline: Strong plain-text protocol that names prior work, claims, countercases and data.
cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Give independent readers equal tasks in random order; compare correct inference, time, accessibility and refusal/exit friction.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: No benefit or greater misunderstanding than baseline.
cards.nonclaim: The number of cards is not the number of scholars or PhDs.
cards.proposal: Finite research cards with source, alternative, testability and loss labels may lower effort to independently evaluate a proposal.
cards.source_gaps: Some underlying donor evidence is private; independent public source verification pending.
cards.strongest_rival: A well-written ordinary scholarly abstract and registered protocol already suffice.
cards.title: Open research cards, not an invented cohort

cards.baseline: Equal-length academically responsible prose with source, alternative and caveats.
cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Randomize reader exposure with opt-in consent; test comprehension, trust calibration, correction and return interest.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Provocation reduces accuracy, excludes readers or attracts unearned confidence.
cards.nonclaim: Memorability does not establish scientific validity.
cards.potential_receiver_benefit: More informed, willing participation without persuasion tricks.
cards.proposal: A provocative public front door may invite inquiry if alternatives and limitations remain one click away.
cards.source_gaps: Public pointers are research framing, not claim proof.
cards.strongest_rival: A conventional clear, neutral summary is more comprehensible and trustworthy.
cards.title: CoStrawBe first contact should expose disagreement

coemergence_definition: Candidate generative synthesis across source disciplines that yields a specified, independently challengeable additional output. Operational effectiveness unproven.
dhp_boundary: DhP is a proposed noncredential research/recognition concept. No institution has awarded or endorsed it; this public-safe packet creates no nominees or recipients.
public_prior_art_caveat: Research ideas may duplicate extant scientific and philosophical work. Formal novelty, academic correctness, and utility are not established.
scope: 12 bounded research questions derived from CoTheoryAll and DhP research lane; no claimed new universal ontology
